## Beazer Homes Stockholders Overwhelmingly Vote to Approve Dream Finders’ Acquisition of Beazer Homes


October 15, 2026 4:05pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_55476a19cd908821dccec6fc0fb98f66/dreamfindershomes/news/2026-10-15_Beazer_Homes_Stockholders_Overwhelmingly_Vote_to_69.pdf)


JACKSONVILLE, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Dream Finders Homes, Inc. (NYSE: DFH) ("Dream Finders") today announced that stockholders of Beazer Homes USA, Inc. (“Beazer”) overwhelmingly voted to approve Dream Finders’ acquisition of Beazer at a special meeting of stockholders held earlier today.


This approval represents a significant milestone and one of the final requirements necessary for Dream Finders to acquire Beazer. As the parties to the proposed transaction already received early termination of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act, Dream Finders expects to consummate the transaction on October 20, 2026, with its already-disclosed available or committed sources of funds.


**About Dream Finders Homes**


Dream Finders (NYSE: DFH), headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, was recognized as the 2025 National Builder of the Year by Builder magazine. Dream Finders builds single-family homes throughout the Southeast, Mid-Atlantic and Midwest, including Florida, Texas, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Colorado, Arizona, and the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area, which comprises Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia and Maryland. As the Official Home Builder of the PGA TOUR, the Jacksonville Jaguars and the Tampa Bay Rays, Dream Finders is deeply committed to excellence beyond homebuilding and into the communities it serves. Through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Dream Finders also provides mortgage financing as well as title agency and underwriting services to homebuyers. Dream Finders achieves its growth and returns by maintaining an asset-light homebuilding model. For more information, please visit[www.dreamfindershomes.com](http://www.dreamfindershomes.com/) .
